description: The one call: add the domain to mxgate, find its DNS host from the NS records (cloudflare, vercel, porkbun), write the required records there, wait until the mxgate check passes, and optionally create the catch-all. DNS host credentials come from the environment of this MCP server (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; VERCEL_TOKEN and VERCEL_TEAM_ID; PORKBUN_API_KEY and PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY) and are never sent to mxgate. When the domain already has MX records for another server the result is a conflict: ask the user, then call again with replace_mx true. Use dry_run to see the plan first. status is done, waiting_for_dns, planned, conflict, needs_credentials or unsupported_dns_host; message says what to do next.

catch_all_to.description: Forward every address at the domain to these mailboxes

dns_provider.description: Skip detection and use this DNS host

dry_run.description: Return the plan and change nothing

replace_mx.description: Delete MX records that point to other mail servers. Only with the user's consent: all mail for the domain moves to mxgate.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the check to pass (default 120)

name: setup_domain
title: Set up a domain end to end
